chunks: Ahmad from Ismail ibn Mihran said, 'Abdul Malik ibn Abi al-Harith narrated to us from Jabir from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said,'

The Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) delivered this sermon, saying: 'All praise is for Allah. I praise Him, seek His help, seek His forgiveness, seek His guidance, believe in Him, and rely upon Him. And I testify that there is no god except Allah, One, with no partner, and I testify that Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) is His servant and His Messenger, whom He sent with guidance and the true religion, to make it prevail over all other religions, as evidence for Him and a caller to Him.'

So He demolished the pillars of disbelief and illuminated the lanterns of faith. Whoever obeys Allah and His Messenger, the path of true guidance becomes his path and the light of piety becomes his evidence; and whoever disobeys Allah and His Messenger misses all true guidance and harms only himself.

I advise you, servants of Allah, with the fear of Allah, as the advice of one who gave sincere counsel and the preaching of one who delivered and strived. Thereafter, indeed Allah, Mighty and Majestic, made Islam an enlightened path, with shining beacons, wherein hearts unite and upon it brothers become brothers. And that which is between us and you from that is constant affection and an ancient covenant, a recognition from each to all of everything upon which we are. May Allah forgive us and you, and peace be upon you, and the mercy of Allah and His blessings.
ai.seo_question: What are the key themes of Amir al-Mu'minin's sermon regarding faith, guidance, and community unity?
ai.summary: Recorded in Al-Kafi, this sermon by Imam al-Sadiq (or Ali, depending on the specific chain interpretation in the marriage chapter context) underscores the theological foundation of Islam as a 'luminous path' that unifies hearts and establishes brotherhood. It highlights the practical implication of *Taqwa* (piety) as the mechanism for social cohesion, reflecting the Shia emphasis on the unity of the community under divine guidance and prophetic example.
